name: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger Vol. 6
original_name: グリザイア ファントムトリガー Vol. 6
source:
Haruto, along with Sengoku, Ukawa, and the other members of the first Phantom Triggers go to visit the grave of their old friend, and the memories of the life of Aoi - a young woman so vicious, and yet so pure - return once more. What events led to Aoi's final moments?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1039970/Grisaia_Phantom_Trigger_Vol6/]Steam[/url]]
